pick.name: Cloudflare Workers AI
pick.what: Serverless open-model inference at the edge, callable from Workers or REST
pick.why: 10,000 free Neurons/day, good for embeddings/small LLM/Whisper next to a Workers-hosted app
pick.free_limits: 10,000 Neurons/day on Free and Paid; $0.011 per 1,000 Neurons above that (Paid only); resets 00:00 UTC; Kimi K2.6/2.7-code, GLM-5.x, DeepSeek V4 need Workers Paid or prepaid AI Gateway credits

alts.name: OpenRouter
alts.why: Best breadth of paid+free models via one key; ZDR routing on every plan
alts.free_limits: Free: 25+ free models, 20 rpm / 50 per day (1,000/day after $10 credits). Fee 5.5% Standard / 8% Business on credit purchases; BYOK first $25k/mo free then 5%

alts.name: Vercel AI Gateway
alts.what: Aggregator with zero token markup, free tier subset of models
alts.why: TS-native with AI SDK; no markup incl. BYOK
alts.free_limits: Free tier = subset of models, per-model rate limits, monthly free credit (amount not on page); buying credits ends free credit; BYOK needs purchased credits

candidates.name: Vercel AI Gateway
candidates.verdict: Alt: zero markup; free credit amount unverified

candidates.name: Hugging Face Inference Providers
candidates.verdict: No free credits for free users

decision: Cloudflare gives a daily free allowance enough for embeddings and small-model fallbacks. Pick OpenRouter when you need a specific open model not on Workers AI; Vercel AI Gateway if you host on Vercel.
details: Vercel free monthly credit amount unverified.

verify.note: Version/licence/limits match registry or official page.
